scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names BACKEND,FRONTEND --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && NODE_ENV=production npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names BACKEND,FRONTEND --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
